header.title: Earlier words give clues
header.intro: Explore how surrounding words help a language model judge what fits.

bridge: The number rows from Stage 2 are processed with the rows around them. Those surroundings provide context clues.

meaning.title: One word, two scenes
meaning.body: Investigate how the same word fits two situations.

builder.title: Give the robot better clues
builder.body: Build a clearer request with useful detail cards.

meaning.instruction: Choose a scene and look for the clue words.
meaning.choosePrompt: Which scene gives the best clues for this word?
meaning.watching: The clues are building a trail to the likely use.
meaning.whyBody: The word itself did not change. The words around it made one use more likely.
meaning.patterns: During training, the model saw many text patterns. It uses those patterns to judge what fits here.
meaning.notHuman: This does not mean the model imagines the scene or understands it exactly like a person. These highlights explain the reviewed example; they are not real attention weights.
meaning.takeaway: The same word can fit different scenes. Surrounding words help the model judge which use is more likely.

money.explanation: “deposited” and “money” make the money-place meaning of “bank” more likely.

river.explanation: “beside” and “river” make the riverside meaning of “bank” more likely.

animal.explanation: “flew” and “cave” make the animal meaning of “bat” more likely.

sport.explanation: “hit” and “ball” make the sports meaning of “bat” more likely.

game.explanation: “football” and “starts” make the game meaning of “match” more likely.

builder.instruction: Give the robot detail cards, then trace what changes in the reviewed response.
builder.robotUnsure: I can answer, but I do not know much yet.
builder.demo: Reviewed teaching output — not a live AI response
builder.lessUseful: This detail does not help much with this task.

effects.usefulPending: Useful clue saved — combine it with another detail to change this reviewed plan
effects.unrelated: Does not meaningfully change the main answer

discoveries.useful: Relevant details can change the plan.
discoveries.extra: Style details can change how it looks or sounds.
discoveries.unrelated: Unrelated details may add noise without helping.

builder.finalDiscovery: Clear, relevant details usually make a response more useful. More words are not automatically better.

party.question: Help me plan a birthday party.

details.blue: The invitation cards will be blue.

responses.base: You could choose some food, games and decorations for the party.
responses.age: Choose a couple of lively activities that suit teenagers, with simple food and decorations.
responses.guests: For eight guests, plan two group games, enough snacks and a shared activity.
responses.budget: With a £50 budget, use homemade decorations, simple snacks and free or low-cost games.
responses.anime: An anime-themed party could use character colours, themed decorations and a matching group game.
responses.themedGroup: For eight guests, plan an anime-themed party with two group games, themed decorations and enough snacks for everyone.
responses.budgetIndoor: For an indoor party on a £50 budget, use two space-friendly games, homemade decorations and simple snacks.
responses.full: For eight teenagers, plan an anime-themed indoor party with two simple group games, homemade decorations and low-cost snacks within the £50 budget.
responses.extra: Blue invitations could add a matching colour to the decorations.

weekend.question: Help me plan a weekend activity.

details.outdoors: They would like to be outdoors.

responses.base: You could choose an activity, decide where to meet and bring what you need.
responses.outdoors: Try a short park walk or outdoor scavenger hunt, and bring water and comfortable shoes.
responses.friends: For four friends, choose a shared activity where everyone can take part together.
responses.budget: With £20, choose a free local activity and keep a little money for drinks or a snack.
responses.rain: Choose a plan with a nearby indoor backup in case it rains.
responses.groupOutdoor: For four friends, try an outdoor scavenger hunt or park challenge where everyone can join in.
responses.budgetRain: Choose a free local activity with an indoor backup, keeping the £20 for travel and simple snacks.
responses.full: For four friends, plan a free outdoor scavenger hunt with an indoor café or library backup if it rains, keeping the £20 for travel and snacks.
responses.extra: Pick one or two scenic stops where the group can take photos.

safeguards.canStillFail: A clearer, more detailed response can still be incorrect. Important facts should still be checked.
safeguards.simple: This is a simplified demonstration using reviewed local examples.
safeguards.noGuarantee: Clear, relevant context is usually more helpful—not simply more context.
